title: Relational AI in Education: Reciprocity, Participatory Design, and Indigenous Worldviews

bias_targets.methodology: Conceptual analysis and theoretical critique of AI systems for extending settler-colonial mindsets, evaluating the epistemic harm of data extractivism on Indigenous knowledge, and proposing Indigenous participatory design and relational ethics to counter these biases.

Qualitative discussion of structural barriers, unequal access to digital infrastructure, and disparities in governance and data sovereignty that disproportionately affect remote and Indigenous communities.
